examples.text: Interdire tout d'abord le recours aux ordonnances dans certaines matières, notamment dans la transposition des directives communautaires qui permettent de faire avaliser par le Parlement, sans discussion ni délibération, des trains entiers de mesures législatives.

glosses: To express support or approval, especially officially or publicly; to give an endorsement.

examples.text: The president endorsed John Smith as senator.

glosses: To write one's signature on the back of a cheque, or other negotiable instrument, when transferring it to a third party, or cashing it.
To add penalty points to one's driving licence as a result of a road traffic offence.

examples.text: The court endorsed his driving record with three penalty points for the drink-driving.
On 25th January, 1968, Mrs. Weston was convicted by the Sheffield Magistrates of driving without due care and attention. She was fined £10 and her driving licence was endorsed.

examples.text: Si mis padres no me hubieran avalado, no hubiera podido comprar la casa.
